mapper.sql: id, payment_id, order_id, user_id, pay_amount, pay_channel, trade_no, subject, pay_status, pay_time, notify_body, gmt_created, gmt_modified
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (payment_id, order_id, user_id, pay_amount, pay_channel, trade_no, subject, pay_status, pay_time) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{payAmount}, #{payChannel}, #{tradeNo}, #{subject}, #{payStatus}, #{payTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM payment_record WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM payment_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT
FROM payment_record WHERE trade_no = #{tradeNo} LIMIT 1
